2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:site_addresses and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Every address your sites answer at: each host, its https address, the installation it shows, and for an earlier name the address it sends visitors on to.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: undefined (list_files, find_file, read_file).
